ITEM 1 | Mixed loose salad greens, bright to dark green leaves with some reddish-purple stems and tips, piled in a loose mound about 10 cm across, slightly wilted and dry-looking, covering roughly 20% of the plate in the upper left | 45
ITEM 2 | Sliced cooked meat, reddish-brown to grey-brown exterior with pinkish interior, slightly seared edges, moist surface, arranged as a fan of thin slices about 7 cm by 5 cm, sitting upper right beside the greens, with a few small green sprigs on top | 60
ITEM 3 | Whole dark red-purple olives or small beans, glossy with slight sheen, smooth skins, clustered in a rounded heap about 9 cm by 6 cm at the lower center of the plate, a few with small stems, some touching the greens | 50
ITEM 4 | Creamy white soft spread, off-white with slight yellowish tint, smooth and moist, spread in a thin layer about 6 cm by 3 cm under a grilled element, partially smeared across the plate near the lower right | 35
ITEM 5 | Grilled bread or toasted flatbread slice, golden-brown with darker char marks and grill lines, dry matte surface, about 6 cm by 3 cm, resting on the creamy spread at the right edge of the plate, topped with small green herb sprigs and a few thin red leaves | 25
